title: Reported Speech: Statement Practice — Quiz 122
content:
## Reported Speech: Statement Practice

Choose the correct tense for each reported statement.

### Lesson focus

1. Uncle said, “I have been vaccinated.”
2. He said, “I posted the letter yesterday.”
3. He said, “I was wearing double mask.”

### Understand the pattern

Present perfect commonly backshifts to past perfect. Past simple can also backshift to past perfect, especially to make the earlier sequence clear. Past continuous commonly becomes past perfect continuous. Change time words only when the reporting time changes.

### Worked answers and explanation

1. Uncle said that he had been vaccinated.
2. He said that he had posted the letter the previous day.
3. He said that he had been wearing a double mask.

The first sentence contains a passive: have been vaccinated becomes had been vaccinated, not had vaccinated.

### Try another

Report later: She said, 'I finished the work yesterday.'

### Suggested answer

She said that she had finished the work the previous day. The past-perfect verb and previous day make the earlier time clear in a later report.
